page.layout: One printed page, text block centre-left; handwritten annotations in the right margin and a faint ghost of the facing page at the left edge (not transcribed). Running head at top, page number top right. Marginal notes in the right margin are manuscript, not printed, so they are described under notes only.

main_text.p: quidam Episcopus, qui ducens secum famelicam turbam militum, miseros subditos non solum pecunia, uerumetiam uictu, pane, pctasonibus, ac omnibus deniq; facultatibus spoliauit. Ille Episcopus fuit tyrannus. Etiam frater ipsius improbauit hoc: et scripsit ad ciuitates, nihil horum fieri suo consilio, se ualde improbare stulticiā & crudelitatē fratris.
main_text.head: Differentia inter latrocinia & legitima bella.
main_text.p: Alexander cæpit piratam, et interrogauit eum quare latrocinium exerceret in mari? At ipse respondit: Quin magis mihi licet latrocinari in mari, quàm tibi in terra. Non recte respondit. Quia latrocinium est ordinis politici confusio: sed bellum legitimum non est latrocinium. Alexander gessit iustum bellum, & puniuit iniustam crudelitatem quam tyranni in suos exercuerant.
main_text.head: Magistratus non debet esse quæstus, sed λατρεγία.
main_text.p: Quidā dominus, cui pater administratione ditionis tradiderat (quia pater maluit alibi uiuere propter suas causas) scripserat patri, sibi non sufficere istos reditus, & uelle uti eius consilio ut peteret superindicta. Illud pater rescisens, gubernationem filij asperrimè tulit: & significauit filio, ut mœnia struerent pro suis opibus: er soll sich strecken, darnach er decke hett.

page.notes: Right margin, handwritten (manuscript, not printed): "Latrocinium & legitimum bellum" beside the Alexander paragraph; "Magistratus non quaestus" beside the Magistratus heading; "darnach er decke hett" is printed text. Marginal ink and a faint ghost of the facing page are not transcribed. Greek "λατρεγία" is as printed (word as best read; doubtful). Catchword "Pul-" is printed at the foot of the text and is treated as a catchword in the text block; the spelling "pctasonibus" appears as printed and may be a misprint for "pelliciis" or similar; "gessit" and "s" forms are long s and are rendered as s.
